examples/tidycrm/test/settle.test.ts::case 1: a conflicted table lists every spelling, consensus first, with nothing chosen
examples/tidycrm/test/settle.test.ts::case 2: choose previews, a plan readies the act with its label, a refusal says why
examples/tidycrm/test/settle.test.ts::case 3: the act prints the planner's rewrites, which is what the write reports filing

deviations_from_card: 1) Settle.tsx is named SettleChooser.tsx: next to settle.ts it collides on a case-insensitive filesystem (tsc TS1149, and './Settle' resolved to settle.ts on Windows). 2) The act label pluralises ('File 1 contact under ...'); the card's template read 'contacts' always. 3) A plan with rewrites === 0 reduces to refused with the write's own 'already' sentence, so the act is never offered to change nothing. 4) Removing the inert spans made the .bk-spelling rules dead and tidycrm-style.test's 'every class the sheet styles is rendered' went red, so they leave components/blocks/style/level2/body.css (the card's named style surface; done under the lock). The chooser uses the existing .bk-chip button with its aria-pressed state and the redline count tone. 5) No ADR: the card names none and the change adds no house decision (ADR 0022 zones kept; the undo path is unchanged).
notes: Undo re-verified against 37f0280: tidycrm's applyUndo still returns void (a clean undo under the additive UndoVerdict) and case 6 passes through undoWrite before and after. Case 3 confirmed the probe: 10 conflicted tables, records - n wrong on exactly 4. The preview sample uses bk-table/bk-truncated with plan.footer. No sibling reds seen. Not verified in a browser.
